content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Selling digital products has become a lucrative avenue for many creators, but the lack of support from popular payment processors can stifle growth. In many regions, payment options are limited or non-existent. For instance, Gumroad charges a significant 10% fee on every sale, which can quickly add up. In contrast, utilizing Bitcoin through NOWPayments incurs only a 0.5% fee. This difference can lead to substantial savings, allowing creators to invest more in their work and sustain their business. Understanding this infrastructure is crucial for creators looking to take control of their financial landscape.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

To implement Bitcoin payments, digital creators can leverage a combination of free and accessible tools to establish a robust sales environment. By using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, along with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, creators can automate order processing and product delivery effortlessly. NOWPayments serves as the payment processor that verifies transactions in real-time, ensuring that creators receive payments directly in their chosen cryptocurrency. This architecture not only minimizes dependency on third-party platforms but also guarantees that creators maintain complete ownership over their digital assets and data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where traditional payment methods are inaccessible, such as Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela. These creators often sell products like ebooks, online courses, and digital templates, but face barriers to monetization due to payment processing limitations. By adopting a Bitcoin payment system, they can navigate these restrictions effectively. The infrastructure is designed for those who seek independence from conventional platforms, allowing them to maximize their earnings while maintaining complete control over their transactions and customer data.
Retain more of your earnings by switching to Bitcoin payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this architecture are selected for their reliability and cost-effectiveness. Creators start with a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages that offers free hosting services. Coupled with backend solutions like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, these components facilitate product loading and order management. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly to provide a crypto payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring versatility for buyers. This stack enables a smooth flow from product selection to payment confirmation, creating a frictionless purchasing experience for customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start accepting Bitcoin payments for digital downloads, first, select your preferred hosting service—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, create your product listings using Google Apps Script for automation or Cloudflare Workers for advanced functionality. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring you choose a network like BSC or Solana for low fees. Test the entire process end-to-end to confirm smooth operations. Finally, you're ready to launch your store and begin selling. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a sovereign ecommerce stack that incorporates Bitcoin payments. By leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can eliminate reliance on traditional payment processors, ensuring a cost-effective solution. This approach allows you to maintain full ownership of your sales data and digital assets.
Say goodbye to 10% platform fees and hello to 0.5% with NOWPayments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads like ebooks or templates without the burden of platform fees, exploring our Complete Builder Kit ($197) can provide you with the architecture you need. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to discover how you can start your journey towards financial independence.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin. This setup eliminates the need for traditional payment processors and allows you to retain more of your earnings.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to use a sovereign stack that includes free hosting, automated backend solutions, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach minimizes costs while maximizing control over your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without Gumroad or Payhip by utilizing your own hosted solution. Use platforms like Cloudflare Pages and integrate NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin payments directly.
What are the advantages of using Bitcoin for payments?

Using Bitcoin for payments offers lower transaction fees compared to traditional platforms. With NOWPayments charging only 0.5%, creators can save significantly compared to platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%.
How do I ensure my transactions are secure?

To ensure secure transactions, utilize NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin payments. This service automatically verifies transactions on-chain, providing real-time confirmation and eliminating the risk of chargebacks.
